name: EQ Preset Indicator
description: Quick Settings tile for the EVO4 EQ smart-filter presets driven by the eq-preset script. Shows the active profile with its icon; clicking toggles between the default profile and the one picked in the preferences (DT-990 headphones by default), the arrow opens a menu to jump straight to any profile. Adds a top-bar icon only while a non-default profile is active. Stays in sync with the <Super><Alt>m/h/e/b hotkeys by watching $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/eq-preset.active.
